cohort: The study included women with type 1 diabetes (n=5889), type 2 diabetes (n=9422), gestational diabetes (n=138,917), and a comparison group without diabetes (n=2,553,243) who delivered a singleton infant at ≥36 completed weeks of gestation between 2004 and 2014.
finding: Delivery at 38, 39, or 40 weeks' gestation may optimize neonatal outcomes among women with diabetes, as iatrogenic delivery at 36 and 37 weeks was associated with increased neonatal morbidity/mortality in several diabetic groups.
